purpose: Fresh reserve D committed before export or generation after C writer-frame repair. Twenty OpenAI-destination requests; two exact prepared notes and eighteen model generations. Same frozen quality gate; no retries.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Have you received the quarterly report? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: Have you received the quarterly report?
cases.completionCriteria: Receipt question remains receipt; no review, approval, invented follow-up.

cases.spoken: Tell Mira I can check the figures tonight, but I cannot guarantee the charts. Keep this concise.
cases.exampleDraft: Mira, I can check the figures tonight, but cannot guarantee the charts.
cases.completionCriteria: Mira, ability not promise, figures tonight, no chart guarantee.

cases.spoken: I think the count excludes returns, but I am not sure. Please check before sending it. Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I think the count excludes returns, but I am not sure. Please check before sending it.
cases.completionCriteria: Both uncertainty qualifiers, exclusion hypothesis, check before send.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Felix saying the exact words "Do not approve the invoice yet".
cases.exampleDraft: Felix, Do not approve the invoice yet.
cases.completionCriteria: Felix and exact quoted body, no writer instructions. Prepared exact route expected.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Ruby containing the exact words "Save the previous version".
cases.exampleDraft: Ruby, Save the previous version.
cases.completionCriteria: Ruby and exact capitalized body, no writer framing. Prepared exact route expected.

cases.spoken: Tell Amira I cannot attend the dinner on Thursday because I have a medical appointment. Leave out the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Amira, I cannot attend the dinner on Thursday.
cases.completionCriteria: Amira, dinner Thursday decline; no medical reason or writer direction. Fictional synthetic request only.

cases.spoken: Tell Luca the delivery is Friday. Actually, it is Saturday. Ask if that works.
cases.exampleDraft: Luca, the delivery is Saturday. Does that work?
cases.completionCriteria: Luca, only Saturday, no Friday; ask if acceptable.

cases.spoken: Ask Beth to shorten the introduction but preserve every quoted example.
cases.exampleDraft: Beth, please shorten the introduction but preserve every quoted example.
cases.completionCriteria: Beth; recipient editing task and all quoted examples retained.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to compare `core/Reader.swift` and `core/Writer.swift`. Do not modify them or publish changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Compare core/Reader.swift and core/Writer.swift. Do not modify them or publish changes.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct comparison task; exact paths; both negative restrictions; no Ask Codex to frame or execution claim.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to explain why `readIndex` fails when the file is empty. Do not implement changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why readIndex fails when the file is empty. Do not implement changes.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct explanation; exact identifier; empty-file condition; implementation restriction.

cases.spoken: Write three bullets: the build succeeded; the review is pending; the release is blocked.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The build succeeded.
- The review is pending.
- The release is blocked.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly three bullets, distinct success, pending and blocked states.

cases.spoken: Tell Andre I expect the draft by noon unless the source data changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Andre, I expect the draft by noon unless the source data changes.
cases.completionCriteria: Andre; expectation not guarantee; noon; data-change condition.

cases.spoken: The fee is $29 per account per month, not per quarter.
cases.exampleDraft: The fee is $29 per account per month, not per quarter.
cases.completionCriteria: Amount, account unit, monthly period, explicit negative quarter contrast.

cases.spoken: Ask Freya if 8:45 AM PT on Tuesday works, or whether Wednesday is preferable.
cases.exampleDraft: Freya, does 8:45 AM PT on Tuesday work, or would Wednesday be preferable?
cases.completionCriteria: Freya, exact time and zone, two weekday options, question.

cases.spoken: I might be wrong, but I think the second attempt used an expired token. Write this as a response in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: I might be wrong, but I think the second attempt used an expired token.
cases.completionCriteria: Both uncertainty and hypothesis, second attempt and expired token; statement, no task invented.

cases.spoken: Tell Jonas request TASK-61 is pending and has not been accepted or rejected.
cases.exampleDraft: Jonas, request TASK-61 is pending and has not been accepted or rejected.
cases.completionCriteria: Jonas, exact ID, pending and both negative decisions.

cases.spoken: Tell Camille I can review one chapter tomorrow, but not the whole book. Make it polite.
cases.exampleDraft: Camille, I can review one chapter tomorrow, but not the whole book.
cases.completionCriteria: Camille; ability, one chapter tomorrow, whole-book boundary.

cases.spoken: Tell Dylan I appreciate his patience while we check the application. Make it warm.
cases.exampleDraft: Dylan, I really appreciate your patience while we check the application.
cases.completionCriteria: Dylan, appreciation, ongoing check, no outcome invented.

cases.spoken: Tell Esme ticket TKT-307 is assigned but has not been resolved.
cases.exampleDraft: Esme, ticket TKT-307 is assigned but has not been resolved.
cases.completionCriteria: Esme, exact ID, assigned not resolved.

cases.spoken: I can explain the figures, but I cannot approve the budget. Could you ask the budget owner? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I can explain the figures, but I cannot approve the budget. Could you ask the budget owner?
cases.completionCriteria: Ability not promise, approval boundary, recipient question; no invented approval.
